gen-gf-happy-monkey-author: Happy Monkey draws its lines with ruler-straight weight and leaves wide gaps in the e, which gives it a bold, odd charm. And Author follows in text serif form, with a slight swell on the bowls that adds a dignified, refined note.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-cabin: Warm and distinctive, Happy Monkey leads with bold display letters, while Cabin lets its bent-tubing shapes and open terminals take over underneath. Paragraphs in this sans-serif feel friendly and easy to follow.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-dm-sans: Friendly is the first word for DM Sans, though Happy Monkey leads. The heading is bold and free of hairlines, and the body's wide-set terminals on the s keep long paragraphs feeling approachable and open.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with little gap between its x-height and caps. Its strongest quality is the way that sturdy text serif sits under Happy Monkey, whose strokes look the same whether upright or sideways.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-aleo: Chunky, glowing and a bit playful: Happy Monkey has a tube-like stroke that resembles neon glass. But if that heading shrinks, its boldness fades, while Aleo's text serif counters let the eye slip in and out.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-almendra-sc: Almendra SC sounds authoritative and dignified below the marker-tip strokes of Happy Monkey. Its serif mouths stay open on c, e and a, so a longer passage reads steadily and with quiet confidence.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-antic-slab: Marker-bold up top, editorial below. The pair's strongest quality is how Happy Monkey's straight, wide-gapped letters meet round serif bowls that never swell or taper.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-arvo: Arvo brings a traditional, dignified serif voice, with curves that refuse to close. Arvo keeps a longer passage feeling grounded, while Happy Monkey's diagonals, as heavy as its verticals, stay loud above it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-belgrano: Happy Monkey has a smooth, drawn-wire feel across a whole sentence, with bold display letters and wide gaps in the e. Belgrano's open-mouthed text serif curves give it a classic, traditional partner.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-biorhyme: Bookish and refined, BioRhyme ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, under Happy Monkey's bold neon-glass tubing. The strongest quality is the pull between glowing heading and widely spaced capitals.
